subject: POC Readout & Final Decision - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@acme-health.com>, Daniel Lopez <daniel.lopez@acme-health.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up & POC plan items from today

Thanks again for a great call today - really appreciate the time. High-level recap and next steps below so we have a shared plan for the trial/POC:

Summary from call:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for clinical summarization pipeline (privacy-preserving, <200ms token latency for 1k concurrent requests)
- Primary success criteria: accuracy vs internal gold set (ROUGE/Likert), latency p50 <200ms, max token cost target $0.003/token

Proposed POC plan (draft):
1) Duration: 2 weeks of full evaluation (sandbox data) + 1 week for readout
2) Deliverables: success criteria spreadsheet (attached), evaluation scripts, sample traffic replay
3) Owners: Acme - Tara (product) + Daniel (engineering); Redwood - me (AM) + Marcus (SE) + Neha (CS)
4) Tech needs: sample dataset (anonymized), API keys, network allowlist for our sandbox

Can you confirm the success criteria in the attached sheet and that the proposed 2-week timeline works? Also, would you aim to schedule an exec readout the week of Mar 15 so your decision-makers can review results?

Attachments: Acme_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx

Next steps: please reply with any edits to the success criteria and your preferred readout window. I can loop in Rishi if we need contractual/POA items after the readout.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0137

From: Daniel Lopez <daniel.lopez@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & POC plan items from today

Thanks Marissa - this is helpful. Quick notes from our side:

- Success criteria: overall looks good. We'll add a pass/fail threshold for clinical hallucination rate (target <2%) and include a small human review sample for edge cases. I'll update the sheet and send back by EOD 3/3.
- Timeline: 2 weeks sounds tight but doable. Can we start data transfer on Mon 3/8? Our infra team needs till then to sanitize samples.
- Readout: Yes, exec review likely the week of 3/15. Favor Tue 3/16 afternoon PT but we can be flexible.

One ask: can your SE provide a short runbook for setup and a smoke-test checklist? That will help our infra team pick this up quickly.

Thanks,
Daniel
Engineering Manager, Platform
Acme Health
+1 (650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-03-02T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: POC plan - Acme Health (action items)

Internal - quick sync on Acme POC:

Per Daniel, they will start data prep and want to transfer samples on Mon 3/8. He requested a runbook/smoke checklist and confirmed exec readout week of Mar 15 (pref 3/16).

Can Marcus please own the technical runbook and coordinate with Daniel's infra? Neha, can you own the evaluation scripts/setup in our sandbox and ensure we collect the metrics listed in the success criteria sheet? Rishi - heads up that this may be ready for exec decision mid-March; we may need POA/SOW follow-up after readout.

I attached the initial success criteria doc. I'll send the client a proposed calendar once we confirm slot availability.

Thanks - Marissa

Attachment: Acme_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Daniel Lopez <daniel.lopez@acme-health.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC plan - Acme Health (runbook & owners)

Thanks - quick plan from the SE side:

- I'll own endpoint provisioning, allowlist, and runbook delivery. Draft runbook attached (SE_Runbook_POC_Checklist.docx).
- Testing plan:
  * Week 1 (3/8-3/12): setup + smoke tests using 1000 sample requests, validate latency baseline
  * Week 2 (3/15-3/19): full-scale replay for throughput, accuracy evals against gold set
  * Readout week (3/15-3/19): deliver dashboard + sample transcripts for exec review
- Tech caveats: for consistent latency we'll use token-level batching disabled and KV cache warmup scripts; Daniel, we should confirm expected request patterns (burst size, avg length).

Attachment: SE_Runbook_POC_Checklist.docx

Will sync with Daniel on Friday 3/5 to finalize the run schedule.

- Marcus

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Scheduling final readout + SOW flow

Tara / Daniel - proposing we lock the exec readout for Mon 3/15 10:00 AM PT (I checked with our execs and that window works); please let me know if you need a different time.

Agenda (30-45 min):
- Quick recap of objectives & success criteria (5 min)
- POC results overview (latency, cost, quality) (15-20 min)
- Live sample walkthrough + Q&A (10-15 min)
- Decision & next steps (5 min)

Decision flow: if your execs give a go at readout, next step would be contract SOW + POA. Rishi will own the SOW and pricing; I'll send a DocuSign link for a standard POA/SOW draft. Attaching Redwood POA for review.

DocuSign/SOW (prelim): https://app.redwood.com/sow/docusign/ACME-POA-2026
Attachment: Redwood_POA_v1.pdf

Thanks - looking forward to the readout.

Best,
Marissa
